title: Come and Hear!
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks and sees, and tonight the psalm-writer calls out “Come and hear” to tell what Heavenly Father has done: Scout prays for his lost bunny, finds it under the bed, and runs to tell the whole family.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout loves sharing good news. In Scout’s world today: Scout prayed to find a lost stuffed bunny, and later that day, there it was under the bed! Scout was so happy and grateful that he ran to tell the whole family, “Heavenly Father helped me find it!” Just like the psalm-writer said, “Come and hear,” Scout shared how Heavenly Father had helped, and everyone’s hearts felt glad.
